description: Review items 2.1/2.2/2.3/2.6/2.7 (backend) + XP unification. Verified today: TutorStore keeps XP in top-level keys (goal 100) and add_xp is never called (tutor reviews give 0 XP); LanguageStore keeps XP in stats (goal 50); displayed streak is never broken until the next study day and daily_xp shows yesterday's value; log_shadowing_session discards text/score/speed; no conversation endpoint; no vocabulary delete. This FEAT adds one XP/streak service shared by both decks, a study stats/dashboard API built from the FEAT-002 review logs, the Pomodoro XP endpoint and the language wiring endpoints. Depends on FEAT-002 (review_log, normalize_card, states).
steps: New app/storage/study_xp.py: constants XP_REVIEW=10, XP_PRONUNCIATION=15, XP_CONVERSATION=25, XP_SHADOWING=20, XP_POMODORO=20, DEFAULT_DAILY_GOAL=100, POMODORO_MIN_MINUTES=5, POMODORO_MAX_MINUTES=90. class StudyXP(dir): file <dir>/xp.json with {schema_version:1, daily:{'YYYY-MM-DD': int}, daily_goal:int, counters:{pomodoros:int}, legacy_streak:{count:int,last_date:str|None}, imported_sources:[...]}; threading.Lock; loads lazily; NEVER writes on construction or read - only add/revoke/set_daily_goal/count_pomodoro persist (mkdir parents then). Methods: add(amount, source, day=None) -> total; revoke(amount, day) (subtract from daily[day], floor 0); set_daily_goal(xp) clamped 10..500; count_pomodoro(); import_legacy(source, total_xp, daily_xp, last_study_date, streak_count, daily_goal) - no-op if source in imported_sources; else in memory: daily[last_study_date] += daily_xp (when last_study_date is set) and a separate int field 'legacy_total' += max(0, total_xp - daily_xp) (daily keys stay pure dates; add 'legacy_total' to the file schema); legacy_streak = the (count,last_date) with the most recent last_date (tie -> max count); daily_goal = max(current, legacy goal); add source to imported_sources (persisted together with the next mutation). summary(today=None) -> {total_xp: legacy_total + sum(daily), daily_xp: daily[today] or 0, daily_goal, goal_met, studied_today, streak, best_streak, pomodoros}; streak = length of the run of consecutive active days ending today, or ending yesterday if today is inactive (else 0), where active days = dates with xp>0 plus the virtual legacy days [last_date-count+1 .. last_date]; best_streak = longest such run. level_for(total) -> {level, name, xp_into_level, xp_for_next, next_threshold} with threshold(n)=50*n*(n-1) (level 1 at 0, 2 at 100, 3 at 300, ...), names ['Iniciante','Aprendiz','Estudante','Dedicado','Focado','Avançado','Expert','Mestre','Sábio','Lenda'], above 10 'Lenda N'. badges(total_reviews, best_streak, total_xp, pomodoros, vocab_count) -> list of {id,label,description,earned} for: first_review 'Primeira revisão' (>=1), reviews_100 '100 revisões', streak_7 'Sequência de 7 dias', streak_30 'Sequência de 30 dias', xp_1000 '1.000 XP', pomodoro_10 '10 Pomodoros', vocab_50 '50 palavras'. Module function get_study_xp(path) caching one instance per Path(path).resolve() (dict + lock).

app/storage/tutor_store.py and app/storage/language_store.py: __init__ gains `xp: StudyXP | None = None`; default xp = get_study_xp(Path('data/study')) when storage_dir is None else get_study_xp(Path(storage_dir) / 'study'); expose self.xp; call self.xp.import_legacy('tutor'|'language', ...) with the legacy fields (tutor: top-level total_xp/daily_xp/last_study_date/streak_count/daily_goal; language: stats.*) - legacy keys stay untouched in progress.json. TutorStore.add_xp(amount) and LanguageStore.add_xp(amount) delegate to self.xp.add(...) and return the new total; remove the private _update_streak math; TutorStore.get_streak_info returns the xp summary in the old key shape (streak_count, last_study_date, total_xp, daily_xp, daily_goal). Tutor review_flashcard now awards XP_REVIEW via xp and logs it in the review entry ('xp': 10); language review/pronunciation/conversation/shadowing award via xp (remove the double _save). undo_last_review revokes via self.xp.revoke(entry['xp'], entry['local_date']) in both stores (replace FEAT-002's temporary language stats math). LanguageStore keeps XP_* names importable (re-export from study_xp) for compat.

app/storage/language_store.py: add delete_vocabulary(card_id) -> bool (removes the card, updates stats.total_vocab and vocab_mastered, saves; review log untouched). log_shadowing_session(text, score=0.0, speed=1.0) -> str: append {id 'shd-<uuid8>', text[:300], score clamped 0..100 rounded 1, speed clamped 0.5..2.0, date} to 'shadowing_history' (keep last 100), increment stats.shadowing_sessions, award XP_SHADOWING, return id. log_conversation_session: clamp topic to 120 chars, corrections/duration_minutes to ints >= 0, new_vocab to list[str] (max 50). get_dashboard: streak/daily_xp/daily_goal/total_xp come from self.xp.summary(); add 'shadowing_sessions' passthrough via stats. set_daily_goal delegates to self.xp.set_daily_goal. get_summary_for_llm reads XP/streak from the xp summary.
app/agent/orchestrator.py: build the default language store as `LanguageStore(xp=getattr(self.tutor_store, 'xp', None))` when language_store is None.

New app/storage/study_stats.py: build_dashboard(tutor, language, now=None) -> {today, due:{flashcards: len(tutor.get_due_flashcards()), vocabulary: len(language.get_due_vocabulary()), next_due_at: earliest of both next_learning_due}, xp: tutor.xp.summary(), level: level_for(total_xp), badges: badges(...)}; build_stats(tutor, language, today=None) -> {heatmap: 371 entries [{date, reviews, xp}] oldest->newest ending today (reviews from both logs' active_reviews by local_date, xp from xp daily), daily_reviews: last 30 days [{date, tutor, language}], retention: {rate: correct/total or None, correct, total, window_days: 30} over active reviews in the window with state_before == 'review' (mature-card retention, Anki 'true retention'), correct = grade >= 1, states: {tutor:{new,learning,review,relearning}, language:{...}, total:{...}} from normalize_card of current cards, totals:{reviews: active review count both decks, pomodoros, vocabulary: len(vocab), flashcards: len(cards)}}.

New app/ui/panel/api/study.py: `_stores(handler)` resolving orchestrator like api/language.py `_store` (tutor_store, language_store). handle_study_get(parts, handler): only claim parts == ['api','study','dashboard'] -> 200 build_dashboard and ['api','study','stats'] -> 200 build_stats; return None for anything else (server.py serves /api/study/categories and /api/study/trash earlier - they must keep working). handle_study_post(path, body, handler): only '/api/study/pomodoro': payload minutes must be int (not bool) within 5..90 else 400 {'ok':False,'error':'invalid_minutes'}; xp.add(XP_POMODORO,'pomodoro'); xp.count_pomodoro(); 200 {ok:True, xp: summary, level}. Register handle_study_get in the GET tuple and handle_study_post in the POST tuple in app/ui/panel/server.py (import next to the tutor/language imports at ~line 20).

app/ui/panel/api/language.py: POST '/api/language/shadowing' {text, score, speed} -> 200 {ok, id}; POST '/api/language/conversation' {topic, corrections, new_vocab, duration_minutes} -> 200 {ok, id} (400 if topic empty); POST '/api/language/vocabulary/{id}/delete' (match by path.split before the fixed-set check) -> 200 {ok:True} or 404 {ok:False,'error':'card_not_found'}. Validate numeric fields without raising 500 (bad values -> 400).

New tests/test_study_xp.py (tmp dirs, explicit `today` values): add accumulates total/daily; next day daily_xp reads 0 without any write; streak 3 for three consecutive days, 0 after a missed day, continues from yesterday when today inactive; best_streak kept; revoke lowers daily and can break today's activity; import_legacy sums tutor+language totals, seeds daily[last_date], keeps most recent legacy streak, max goal, and is idempotent across a new StudyXP instance after persistence; no file is written by construction/summary (assert path not exists); level thresholds 0/99/100/300 and names; badges earned flags; get_study_xp returns the same instance for the same path.

New tests/test_study_api.py: HTTP fixture copied from tests/test_panel_tutor_api.py but injecting xp = StudyXP(tmp/'study'), TutorStore(tmp/'tutor', xp=xp), LanguageStore(tmp/'language', xp=xp), EnemStore(tmp/'enem') and monkeypatched session_store paths. Cover: GET /api/study/dashboard keys and due counts; after a tutor review + vocab review, GET /api/study/stats shows today's heatmap reviews == 2 and xp == 20, daily_reviews today {tutor:1, language:1}, retention rate None (no review-state reviews) and then a float after reviewing a graduated card (use store with a migrated legacy review-state card), states totals add up to card counts; POST /api/study/pomodoro {minutes:25} -> 200 and xp +20, {minutes:2}/{minutes:200}/{minutes:'25'} -> 400; POST /api/language/vocabulary/{id}/delete -> 200 then 404; POST /api/language/shadowing and /api/language/conversation -> 200 and dashboard stats counters + XP increase; GET /api/study/categories still 200 (not shadowed).

Update tests/test_language_store.py::test_dashboard_defaults (daily_goal 100 = unified goal) and any XP-shape assertion that changed; tests/test_tutor_store.py: add a test that a tutor review awards 10 XP via store.xp.summary().
Commit (stage by name): `feat(estudos): XP/sequência unificados, API de painel e estatísticas, endpoints de idiomas`.
acceptance_criteria: Tutor and language XP/streak come from one StudyXP instance; tutor reviews award XP; streak shows 0 after a missed day; daily_xp resets on a new day without writes.
Legacy XP data is imported once (idempotent) and legacy keys are not removed.
GET /api/study/dashboard and /api/study/stats return the documented shapes with non-zero values after activity; /api/study/categories still works.
POST /api/study/pomodoro validates minutes and awards 20 XP.
Shadowing, conversation and vocabulary delete endpoints work and persist data.

Verification: 231 passed, 2 failed - the 2 failures are tests/test_tool_catalog.py (general tool 'personal_records' has no TOOL_CATALOG entry); they fail identically on a clean checkout of de29883 (checked in a temp worktree), are in the habits/personal-records area owned by the parallel investigation, and were not touched. A git auto-gc 'Unlink of file .git/objects/pack/...idx failed' prompt hung after the commit (pack locked by another process); the commit succeeded. NEW FILES: app/storage/study_xp.py (StudyXP, get_study_xp, level_for, badges, XP_* constants, POMODORO_MIN/MAX_MINUTES), app/storage/study_stats.py (build_dashboard, build_stats), app/ui/panel/api/study.py. Shared XP file: data/study/xp.json (or <storage_dir>/study/xp.json when a store gets an explicit storage_dir and no xp). The orchestrator's default LanguageStore reuses tutor_store.xp. StudyXP.summary() also returns 'last_study_date' (latest active day <= today, or null), on top of the planned keys. Level names: levels 1..10 = Iniciante..Lenda, level 11 = 'Lenda 2', 12 = 'Lenda 3', and so on. Tutor reviews award 10 XP and log 'xp': 10; undo (either deck) revokes entry.xp from the review's local_date. RESPONSE SHAPES: XpSummary = {total_xp:int, daily_xp:int, daily_goal:int, goal_met:bool, studied_today:bool, streak:int, best_streak:int, pomodoros:int, last_study_date:'YYYY-MM-DD'|null}. Level = {level:int, name:str, xp_into_level:int, xp_for_next:int, next_threshold:int} (threshold(n)=50*n*(n-1)). Badge = {id:'first_review'|'reviews_100'|'streak_7'|'streak_30'|'xp_1000'|'pomodoro_10'|'vocab_50', label:str (pt-BR), description:str (pt-BR), earned:bool}. GET /api/study/dashboard -> 200 {today:'YYYY-MM-DD', due:{flashcards:int, vocabulary:int, next_due_at:ISO-UTC|null}, xp:XpSummary, level:Level, badges:Badge[7]} | 503 {ok:false,error:'study_store_unavailable'}. GET /api/study/stats -> 200 {heatmap:[{date,reviews:int,xp:int}] x371 oldest->newest (last = today), daily_reviews:[{date,tutor:int,language:int}] x30 oldest->newest, retention:{rate:float(0..1, 4 decimals)|null, correct:int, total:int, window_days:30}, states:{tutor:{new,learning,review,relearning}, language:{...}, total:{...}} (ints), totals:{reviews:int, pomodoros:int, vocabulary:int, flashcards:int}}. POST /api/study/pomodoro {minutes:int 5..90} -> 200 {ok:true, xp:XpSummary, level:Level} | 400 {ok:false,error:'invalid_minutes'} (missing, bool, string, float or out of range). POST /api/language/shadowing {text:str, score?:number (default 0, clamped 0..100), speed?:number (default 1, clamped 0.5..2)} -> 200 {ok:true,id:'shd-xxxxxxxx'} | 400 {ok:false,error:'invalid_payload'} (non-number score/speed); awards 20 XP and stores progress.shadowing_history[{id,text,score,speed,date}]. POST /api/language/conversation {topic:str (required, max 120), corrections?:number, new_vocab?:string[] (max 50), duration_minutes?:number} -> 200 {ok:true,id:'conv-xxxxxxxx'} | 400 {ok:false,error:'topic_required'} | 400 {ok:false,error:'invalid_payload'}; awards 25 XP. POST /api/language/vocabulary/{id}/delete (body ignored) -> 200 {ok:true} | 404 {ok:false,error:'card_not_found'}. GET /api/language/dashboard keeps its shape; streak/daily_xp/daily_goal/total_xp now come from the unified XpSummary (default daily_goal 100), and stats always has shadowing_sessions. Note that stats.* legacy XP keys (total_xp/daily_xp/streak_count/daily_goal) are stale snapshots, so the frontend must not read them. POST /api/language/settings {daily_goal} now sets the unified goal (clamped 10..500).
